python3 << 'EOF'
# Customs duty rates for FY1939-1941

# From the data:
# FY1939: Duties = 312,095; Value = 820,157 (from 1940 bulletin)
# FY1940: Duties = 340,006; Value = 919,709 (from 1940 bulletin)
# FY1941: Duties = 385,306; Value = 1,011,262 (from 1941 bulletin)

fy1939_duties = 312095
fy1939_value = 820157
fy1940_duties = 340006
fy1940_value = 919709
fy1941_duties = 385306
fy1941_value = 1011262

# Calculate duty rates
rate_1939 = fy1939_duties / fy1939_value
rate_1940 = fy1940_duties / fy1940_value
rate_1941 = fy1941_duties / fy1941_value

print(f"FY1939 duty rate: {rate_1939:.6f}")
print(f"FY1940 duty rate: {rate_1940:.6f}")
print(f"FY1941 duty rate: {rate_1941:.6f}")

# Centered moving average (average of the 3 years)
cma = (rate_1939 + rate_1940 + rate_1941) / 3
print(f"\nCentered moving average: {cma:.6f}")
print(f"Rounded to 3 decimal places: {round(cma, 3)}")
EOF
